Best NAS for streaming a FLAC music library with Navidrome or Plexamp (2026) · Dealectric

chats.answer:
For streaming a FLAC music library using Navidrome or Plexamp, I'd prioritize a NAS with an Intel CPU, Docker support, quiet operation, and reliable storage over raw processing power.

My top choices are Synology DS224+, Synology DS423+, and UGREEN NASync DXP2800.

The important distinction is that Navidrome is extremely lightweight, while Plexamp uses Plex Media Server, which can benefit from additional CPU power for transcoding, sonic analysis, and library processing.

What matters for a FLAC music NAS

CPU: Intel x86 is a good choice, particularly if Plex needs to transcode audio or analyze a large library.

RAM: 4 GB is sufficient for basic music serving; 8 GB is preferable for Docker and additional services.

Storage: Mirrored drives (RAID 1) are a good starting point. A pair of 4 TB drives can store a substantial FLAC collection.

Networking: Gigabit Ethernet is more than enough for multiple simultaneous lossless audio streams.

Software: Docker/Container Manager support makes running Navidrome straightforward. Plex Media Server should also be supported.

Noise: For a music-focused setup, fan noise and hard-drive vibration may matter more than performance.
